product.title: St Andrews & the Fishing Villages of Fife Small-Group Day Tour from Edinburgh

description.text: Travel from Edinburgh across the Forth Bridge into Fife for Anstruther, St Andrews, and Falkland on a small-group Mercedes mini-coach day. The East Neuk fishing villages and the Old Course town share the 8.5-hour outing, with time at Scotland's oldest university and coastal harbour streets. Stops include Forth Bridge, Anstruther, St Andrews, Falkland. Hotel pickup and a 16-guest maximum keep the Fife day closer to a private circuit than a large coach. Lomond Hills views appear between the coastal villages and Falkland. Ideal for visitors basing in Edinburgh who want a guided St Andrews and Fife day without self-driving.

highlights: Full-day small group tour to St. Andrews and Fife by mini-coach
Plenty of time in St Andrews, home of golf and Scotland's oldest university
Small-group tour with a maximum of 16 people for a more personalized experience
